messages:
alex: Heads-up — seeing a sudden spike of cross-region traffic (US -> EU -> US) and a ton of fallback decisions. Latency from 60ms -> 400ms for some pro customers. Anyone touching routing policies?
priya: I got the telemetry alerts 3m ago. Traces show thousands of decisions where requested_region=us-east but chosen_region=eu-west with model_variant=gpt-small-v2-quant.
ben: i rolled a change last week to allow model-variant cross-region fallback for capacity smoothing. It was gated by a heuristic but maybe the weight calc is off :/
maya: logs (snippet):
```
route_decision: {customer: "acme-inc", tier: "pro", req_region: "us-east-1", decision: "fallback", chosen_region: "eu-west-1", model: "gpt-small-v2-quant", reason: "capacity_high", score: 0.49}
```
maya: note the score threshold was 0.5, why did 0.49 get chosen? should be rejected.
ben: ugh — looks like we compare floats in a fuzzy way in the new comparator. I accidentally allowed >= instead of > when comparing `score` against `region_pref_score`. I'll push a hotfix.
alex: before a deploy: can we clamp cross-region fallback for tier=pro and enterprise? We should fail closed to same-region for premium customers.
leo: +1. quick ACL: set `routing.policies.cross_region_fallback: false` for tenant_tiers ["pro","enterprise"] via console. That should stop new cross-region selections.
routing-bot: :information_source: Policy change queued by leo. Preview: disable cross-region fallback for tiers [pro, enterprise].
oncall-ml: also seeing a fallback loop where eu-west returns MODEL_UNAVAILABLE and then we route to another region which also falls back to eu-west because quantized variant mapping points there. Causing oscillation.
priya: i captured a loop trace (condensed):
```
1) us-east -> eu-west (gpt-small-v2-quant) -> MODEL_UNAVAILABLE
2) router tries fallback -> eu-central (gpt-small-v2-quant) -> capacity_high -> router chooses eu-west again
```
priya: that's a bug in the 'avoid-repeat' logic. we only track last region per request but not per fallback chain.
ben: fix plan: 1) short-circuit cross-region fallback for protected tiers (config) 2) add per-decision history set so same region isn't re-selected in the same chain 3) revert comparator bug
maya: i'm applying the config change now in staging then prod. ETA ~5m.
routing-bot: :white_check_mark: Policy change applied to prod flag `routing.cross_region.allowed_tiers` -> removed [pro, enterprise].
alex: monitoring: reduce cross-region egress by 90%? reports?
priya: eyeballing Live Dashboard: cross-region requests dropped ~72% in first 2m, latency for affected customers trending back down. still some residual due to in-flight requests.
oncall-ml: i'm running a quick script to flush pending fallback chains at the edge for active requests with loop depth >2. will post PR for permanent fix.
ben: PR #482: comparator fix + history set for fallback chain. Contains unit tests for loop detection.
maya: review & deploy after ben's PR merges. also we should add an alert: "cross-region-fallback-rate > 1% for pro-tier".
alex: agree. action items: (1) monitor for 30m (pri), (2) merge ben PR and rollout canary (ben/maya), (3) add dashboard + alert (pri/leo), (4) retro and policy doc update (alex).
leo: i'll make the dashboard panels and alert rule. assigning to myself and priya.
priya: thanks. filing a short postmortem draft after we stabilize.
ben: rolled comparator fix to canary at 1763504560.
routing-bot: :rocket: Deploy canary v2026.03.12-cmpfix to 5% routing plane at 1763504600.
maya: canary looks clean at 1m, promoting to 50% now.
alex: nice work team — keep a close eye on telemetry. we'll re-open if anything spikes. :thumbsup:
